newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: YUGOSLAV JUNE CONSTRUCTION WORKS UP ON MAY.
newsitem.headline: YUGOSLAV JUNE CONSTRUCTION WORKS UP ON MAY.

text.p: The Federal Statistics office reported the following economic indicator details.
NOTES -- Cumulative number of workers in the January-June period dropped 5.0 percent against the same six-month period in 1996.

At the end of June, the value of concluded building contracts stood at 2.494 billion dinars versus 2.257 billion at the end of May. The data refer to contracted construction works to be carried out during the year regardless of when the orders were made.
The data cover major construction companies accounting for around 80 percent of total annual value of construction works.
The number of workers excludes engineers and technicians.
The number of hours excludes hours put in by engineers and technicians.
Figures refer to the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro.
